name: Kanbujian de Lianren
source:
《The Invisible Lover》
I’m not sure when it started, but recently, a lot of "Invisible Lover" services have popped up online.
After purchasing, the other person pretends to be your lover.
They comfort you, chat with you, and keep you company through your phone and messaging apps.
I don’t know why this kind of service exists,
or who would even need something like this.
But the reason I’m so interested in "Invisible Lovers" is because—
one of them lives right next door to me.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/701930/Short_Stories_Collection_of_Class_Tangerine/]steam[/url]]
translation:
《看不见的爱人》不知道从什么时候开始，最近网上突然出现了很多“隐形情人”的服务。
购买后，对方冒充你的情人。
他们通过你的手机和消息应用程序安慰你、与你聊天并陪伴你。
我不知道为什么会有这种服务，
或者谁甚至需要这样的东西。
但我对《看不见的恋人》如此感兴趣的原因是——
其中一位就住在我隔壁。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/701930/Short_Stories_Collection_of_Class_Tangerine/]steam[/url]]
